title.narrative: Design of Project for Resilient and Energy Efficient Water Access in Urban Low Income Areas in Ghana 2025-2026

description.narrative: Assist in the design of the project and the formulation of both the draft project document to be submitted to the Programme committee in the MFA as well as the final project document.

The embassy of Denmark in Accra Ghana is hiring a consultant to assist with the formulation of a Danish project related to access to water and energy efficiency titled “Resilient and Energy Efficient Water Access for Urban Low Income Areas in Ghana”. The project will be formulated in close cooperation with UNICEF Ghana (implementing partner) and Ghana Water Limited and the Ministry of Water and Sanitation (national counterpart). The Consultant must provide the service and outputs described in this document and its appendixes at the price determined by the Client.
